# Devicons

> Free developer icons and logos library. 1,300+ optimized SVGs plus React, Vue, Svelte, and Astro components — MIT licensed.

Devicons is a catalog of developer-brand logos (frameworks, databases, cloud providers, tools) designed to be used in diagrams, docs, comparison pages, and UI. Every icon is available as a raw SVG, a CDN asset, an npm component for React/Vue/Svelte/Astro, and an icon-font glyph.

## Machine-readable entry points

- [Full icon catalog (Markdown)](https://devicons.io/icons.md): every icon with slug, name, tags, aliases
- [Search index (JSON)](https://devicons.io/search-index.json): ~1,300 entries for agent-side lookup
- [Homepage (Markdown)](https://devicons.io/index.md)
- [Documentation index (Markdown)](https://devicons.io/docs.md)
- [Packs index (Markdown)](https://devicons.io/packs.md): curated logo sets (MERN, JAMstack, DevOps, etc.)
- [Comparisons index (Markdown)](https://devicons.io/compare.md): curated A-vs-B pairs
- [Sitemap](https://devicons.io/sitemap-index.xml)

## Agent integration

- [Skill reference (Markdown)](https://devicons.io/skill.md): full agent-usage guide
- [Agent Skills manifest](https://devicons.io/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): discoverable via AgentSkills v0.2
- [Skill icons reference](https://devicons.io/skill/reference/icons.md): canonical icon lookup table
- [Skill packages reference](https://devicons.io/skill/reference/packages.md): @dev.icons/* package APIs

## Per-icon Markdown

Every icon page has a Markdown alternate at `https://devicons.io/icons/{slug}.md` (e.g. `/icons/react.md`, `/icons/postgresql.md`). Each file includes the icon's name, description, tags, aliases, website, license, variants, CDN URLs, and framework import snippets.

## Usage summary

- Install: `npm install @dev.icons/react` (also `/vue`, `/svelte`, `/astro`), or load the web font with `@import "devicons/css";`
- CDN SVG: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@dev.icons/core@latest/export-files/icons/{slug}.svg`
- Component naming: slug → PascalCase + `Icon` suffix (e.g. `react` → `ReactIcon`, `next-js` → `NextJsIcon`)
- License: MIT for the library; each brand retains its own trademark
